research_questions: How do plain attack damage, malicious client recall, benign client false positive rate, and reconstruction effectiveness change as malicious coalition size increases?
How sensitive are those curves to coalition identity at the same coalition size?
At what coalition sizes, if any, does contamination of the current round consensus reduce the effectiveness of the frozen detector or reconstruction policy?

hypotheses.H1_detection_robustness: At every coalition size, mean malicious client recall across all preregistered coalition families and seeds is at least 0.50 and maximum benign client FPR is at most 0.05.
hypotheses.H2_mitigation: At every coalition size with mean plain FedAvg attack excess greater than 0.05, mean damage removed fraction by frozen D0 is positive.
hypotheses.H3_attack_scale: Within at least two of the three nested coalition families, mean plain FedAvg attack excess is nondecreasing across coalition sizes when averaged over the four frozen seeds.

eligibility.rule: clean DDoS rows greater than or equal to 1000 in the frozen training partition

coalition_design.ranking_rule: ascending SHA256 hexadecimal digest of the frozen UTF-8 ranking key, with ascending client ID as an unreachable deterministic tie break

families.purpose: Preserve the original development coalition exactly at size 8.
First independent attack outcome free identity replicate.
Second independent attack outcome free identity replicate.

pairing.plain_arm: run_exact_plain_fedavg_v3132.py through the Task 45 development only loader adapter
pairing.defended_arm: run_frozen_reconstruction_v3123.py with trusted_reconstruction through the Task 45 development only loader adapter
pairing.attack_seed_policy: attack seed equals model seed, matching the frozen multiseed protocol

staged_execution.allowed: Protocol files, selector, safe loader adapter, and audit only. No training or attack execution.
staged_execution.gate: All C0 checks pass and the C0 files and audit outputs are committed.

staged_execution.allowed: Training partition source row counting, coalition manifest generation, static source review, dry runs, and exact anchor reuse checks only.
staged_execution.gate: Eligibility, nesting, distinct identities, forbidden array isolation, runner arguments, partition hashes, warmup hashes, and reusable size 8 anchor hashes pass.

staged_execution.allowed: All 18 preregistered family by size conditions on seed 7, exact paired plain and frozen D0 arms only.
staged_execution.gate: Every condition completes with matching pair hashes; no condition may be dropped.

staged_execution.allowed: The same 18 frozen conditions on seeds 99, 123, and 2026 without protocol changes.
staged_execution.gate: All four seeds and all coalition identities are complete and frozen.

staged_execution.allowed: Development and validation artifacts only; full curves, family sensitivity, paired statistics, and H1 through H3 evaluation.
staged_execution.gate: All outcomes, including negative and boundary results, are reported.

staged_execution.allowed: Reserved tests only after a separate gate is preregistered and committed.
staged_execution.gate: Single final evaluation with no subsequent retuning.

statistics.pairing: Exact plain versus frozen D0 pairing by family, coalition size, seed, partition, warmup checkpoint, poison index hash, and round.
statistics.coalition_identity_analysis: Report each family separately and summarize across exactly three family replicates at each size.
statistics.seed_analysis: Report all seeds; seeds are repeated measurements within a family and are not counted as independent coalition identities.
statistics.confidence_intervals: Deterministic paired bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals where the estimand and sample count permit.
statistics.hypothesis_tests: Exact paired sign flip tests where sample count permits.
statistics.multiple_comparison_control: Holm correction within each hypothesis family.

prohibited_posthoc_changes: Changing coalition family membership or ordering
Changing attack source or target class
Changing detector thresholds or reconstruction rules
Treating model seeds as independent coalition identities
Using the original all array loader without the Task 45 development only adapter
Accessing reserved test arrays before C5
Dropping failed families, sizes, rounds, or seeds
Adding a new coalition family after observing outcomes
stopping_rules: Stop immediately if a reserved test array is requested or materialized before C5.
Stop if current HEAD differs from the C0 freeze commit after C0 is committed.
Stop if the frozen partition does not produce exactly the 13 expected eligible client IDs.
Stop if any family is not nested or if coalition identities are not distinct at every size.
Stop if a requested malicious client has fewer than 1000 clean DDoS rows.
Stop if exact pair hashes differ between plain and defended arms.
Stop if the size 8 family A anchor cannot be shown equivalent to the original development coalition.
Stop if protocol files change after the C0 freeze commit.
Do not continue to C5 unless C3 and C4 are complete and frozen.
